text: Amazon's typical prices are well above Meesho's in most categories today, and festive lights and gold coins rank high just before Diwali and Dhanteras. For a beginner, small home items and fitness accessories look most approachable, while earbuds, personal care and beauty are led by big brands.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets and silk-look sarees lead
text: Anarkali kurta sets from Klosia and GoSriKi and Kanjivaram-style sarees top the lists. The typical price is about ₹615, more than double Meesho's ₹288. Among the top 10 products, about 10.9% of reviews are 1-star, the highest of any category here, so quality complaints are a real risk. Kurtas have sizes, which usually means returns, so free-size sarees are the easier way in.

headline: Women's western: tops and maxi dresses from smaller labels
text: Tops and shirts carry most of the reviews, and many top-ranked dresses and tops have only a few hundred reviews, which suggests newer listings can rank here. The typical price is about ₹428, above Meesho's ₹290. Among the top 10 products, about 10.4% of reviews are 1-star, and some ratings are as low as 3.5. Sizes and quality are the main risks, so start with a small range.

headline: Men's clothing: known brands in shirts, jackets for winter
text: Allen Solly and Louis Philippe polos rank high, and winter jackets and hooded sweatshirts from Lymio and Alan Jones lead the winter list. The typical price is about ₹549, compared with Meesho's ₹299. Among the top 10 products, about 8.8% of reviews are 1-star. Winter demand looks real, but big brands and sizing make this a hard place to start.

headline: Kids & toys: toys carry the demand, clothing sets are new
text: Toys hold nearly all the reviews here, led by a kick scooter and a tricycle, while top kids' clothing sets have very few reviews so far. The typical price is about ₹455, compared with Meesho's ₹183. Among the top 10 products, about 8.9% of reviews are 1-star. Small toys have no sizes and are easier to ship, though toys sold in India have safety rules you should read about before stocking.

headline: Home & kitchen: useful gadgets and Diwali lights
text: A ₹204 kitchen scale and a ₹264 electric gas lighter lead Kitchen & Dining, while LED lights and tealight candles fill Home & Décor just before Diwali, including Amazon's own Solimo brand. The typical price is about ₹289, compared with Meesho's ₹152. Among the top 10 products, about 10.1% of reviews are 1-star, so check quality carefully. It's too late to start Diwali stock now, but small, light, useful items suit beginners.

headline: Beauty: everyday soaps and face wash from known brands
text: Dettol, Ghar Soaps and similar names lead with low prices, and the typical price is about ₹249, closer to Meesho's ₹175 than most categories. Ratings are the highest of any category at about 4.26, and only about 5.5% of reviews on the top 10 products are 1-star. Reselling brands needs authorisation and making your own cosmetics needs a licence, so this stays hard for a beginner.

headline: Jewellery: gold coins spike before Dhanteras
text: Gold coins and pendants costing ₹15,000 or more rank near the top with few reviews, a sign of Dhanteras buying that is likely short-lived and not suited to a beginner. Fashion jewellery like earring sets and bangles sits lower with a much lower price, and the typical price across the list is about ₹275, compared with Meesho's ₹166. Among the top 10 products, about 9.4% of reviews are 1-star. These items are light with no sizes, and wedding season is ahead.

headline: Bags & footwear: comfort slippers and work bags
text: Comfort and orthopedic slippers lead women's shoes, and office bags and crossbody bags lead handbags, with some bags ranking high on about 1,000 reviews. The typical price is about ₹567, about three times Meesho's ₹188. Among the top 10 products, about 7.6% of reviews are 1-star. Bags have no sizes and suit a beginner better than footwear, which usually means more returns.

headline: Electronics: chargers and earphones from big brands
text: OnePlus, Samsung, boAt, Portronics and Ambrane dominate with very high review counts, and this list has some of the strongest demand here. The typical price is about ₹649, compared with Meesho's ₹341. Among the top 10 products, about 10.1% of reviews are 1-star. Competing with these brands in earbuds or chargers is hard, so only simple unbranded accessories like holders and cable protectors are worth checking.

headline: Health & fitness: handwash leads, fitness gear is open
text: Dettol and Dabur handwash lead Personal Care, which a beginner can't easily compete with. In Exercise & Fitness, pull-up bars and dumbbells rank high with fewer reviews. The typical price is about ₹318, compared with Meesho's ₹235, and the 1-star share on the top 10 products is the lowest here at about 4.6%. Small, light fitness accessories suit a beginner far better than heavy equipment.

Small kitchen gadgets such as gas lighters and scales, once you've checked quality.
Light fitness accessories such as resistance bands.
Work bags and crossbody bags, which have no sizes.
Fashion earring and bangle sets, ahead of wedding season.
Small toys, after reading the toy safety rules.
Avoid for now: earbuds and chargers (big brands), gold jewellery, branded beauty and personal care (authorisation), sized clothing (returns), and Diwali-only stock (too late to start).
